text.en: What do Leonardo da Vinci, Benjamin Franklin, and Ada Lovelace have to teach us about creativity in the age of AI?
text.th: What do Leonardo da Vinci, Benjamin Franklin, and Ada Lovelace have to teach us about creativity in the age of AI?

text.en: On our newest episode of Dialogues on Technology and Society, Kent Walker sits down with biographer and historian Walter Isaacson to talk about why history's biggest breakthroughs have always been a team sport. They look at why curiosity and human judgment matter more than ever when information is right in your pocket.
